# Golden parity inputs

The compressed v3 and v4 indexes were generated from the November migration bundle in dashboard commit
`67aa36b81092567d47feaa401c7e448a09d395ea` using Crucible's `phase-2` at `a7846b8`.
They are the inputs for comparison with `docs/rewrite/golden-numbers.json`. Leave them frozen when
publishing new results. Only the two suite indexes are needed by the parity tests.
